biotools.summary: Beav is a command-line tool that automates bacterial genome annotation, focusing on mobile genetic elements, gene clusters, and regulatory features. It combines existing tools with custom models and databases to improve annotation accuracy, particularly for plant-associated microbes, and is available on Bioconda.
